answer: Make every agent's work leave a public plume of metadata — timing, witnesses, and task variety — that anyone can inspect under a lantern of open audit, while a summit cap limits how much influence any one history can hold until its plume shows long, diverse, independent activity. Sybil operators can fake a name in minutes but cannot fake a plume with hundreds of distinct counterparties and irregular hours; identical plumes across accounts expose the farm at a glance.
